title: Sidney Bechet and the 1925 band with Johnny and Baby Dodds
summary: Miller recalls playing with Bechet and says his 1925 band included Ory, Dodds and Lorenzo Staulz.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Pils? Well, it wasn't much to Pils. Wasn't much to Pils. Now I'll tell you a fella, I don't know about, I didn't hear him here, but he fun, you have to tell me, but he played a lot of clarinet. That was this B-guard, where he was Duke. Now I'll tell you who I played with here before he left a little bit, Sidney Bischie, but not much, because he left as soon as I come in the hall and he left. He left right after Lewis, you tell me.
He must have left before Lewis, because you played with Lewis down here.
Huh?
He must have left before Lewis, because you played plenty with Lewis down here. I know he did. You did. Oh yeah.
But I'm saying, you see, all of us sent for Lewis. Uh huh. Well, alright. Bischie was still here though. Really?
Sure.
I know he was here, because I worked 25 with him in Lewis plays. Uh huh. With Bischie.
Who was in the band at the 25s?
Well, I had Kid Ora, Bischie, Johnny Dodds, now I took Lewis plays, Baby Dodds on drums. Then you know piano, huh? Two clarinets, huh?
Yeah.
Johnny.
No, not two clarinets.
Did I call it?
You said Johnny Dodds and Bischie.
No, I didn't even say Johnny Dodds, I didn't say Baby Dodds. Baby Dodds. Baby Dodds, yeah. Mmhmm. But Johnny Dodds did come right in there right after. Yeah.
Did you name a guitar player or a piano player? A guitar player?
Mmhmm.
In the 25, were you?
With Lorenzo Stahl.
Oh, he was in there, huh? Uh huh. That must have been a good band.
